purpose: 通用记分 V1 静态设计评审
prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished HIGH FIDELITY Chinese WeChat mini-program UI design review board, landscape 1792x1200 or comparable high resolution, with THREE LARGE equally sized portrait phone screen mockups side by side. Title 'FunBox / 通用记分 V1', subtitle '01 入口 · 创建 · 等待'. Faithfully continue the existing project's design: light gray blue #f5f7fa, white rounded cards, electric blue #2d5bff, navy #172139, muted #7b879c, coral accents #ff765e; very soft shadows and small friendly rounded 3D blue plus/minus score board illustrations. Chinese PingFang typography crisp and highly legible. Clean practical mini-program, not a flashy redesign. No physical device frames. Show mini-program status and navigation bars. No Mahjong elements anywhere except the EXISTING Mahjong entry on homepage; all NEW generic pages contain NO mahjong, cards, dice, chips, compass positions, game seats.
SCREEN 1 home: FunBox small brand and '好友记分', user chip '游客'. Hero '好友相聚，每局都算数。' with small generic 3D blue plus minus score tile. Section '选择记分方式'. Three stacked modest cards, existing '麻将记分' subtitle '4 人牌局 · 给分与结算', existing '炸金花' subtitle '轮流加注，实时看池', NEW highlighted light periwinkle card '通用记分' subtitle '灵活人数 · 给分与结算' small '新功能' badge, generic plus/minus score board icon. New card clearly visible above bottom tabs '首页' '我的'. Keep first two entries visually subdued, generic entry focus.
SCREEN 2 titled '通用记分'. Hero '相聚不设限，记分一样清楚' tiny generic 3D plus/minus icon. Tabs '创建房间' selected / '加入房间'. Main white card with heading '创建房间', inline editable room name '周末好友局' pencil, field '你的昵称' input '小林', lock row '房间密码 666666' pencil. A separate lightweight tinted note with people outline icon '2 人即可开始，人数不设固定名额', smaller '成员按实际加入展示'. Informational note '先记分，结束时再结算'. Prominent blue '创建房间' button. footer '扫码或转发邀请，游客也能加入'. No participant count selector. This is a proposed dynamic capacity concept, not four fixed seats.
SCREEN 3 titled '通用记分'. Compact white header '周末好友局', meta '房间 682915', green '实时同步', pill '等待开始'. Invite card '邀请好友加入' with '房间码 682915' and small sample QR, blue '发送邀请给好友'. Section '房间成员' '已加入 6 人'. Six compact rows numbered circular avatar with Chinese initial (林,杰,雨,北,可,安), names 小林 with 我 房主 tags, 阿杰, 小雨, 阿北, 可可, 阿安. Each row small green dot '已加入'. No empty fixed slots, no four-seat grid. Bottom note '2 人起即可开始，无需等满'. Fixed fullwidth blue '开始记分' button.
Below each screen use brief editorial captions '新增独立入口' / '无需预设人数' / '成员列表自然扩展'. Entire board is an initial design proposal, not a screenshot of implemented code. Render all Chinese text correctly. No excessive decorative or English text.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished HIGH FIDELITY Chinese WeChat mini-program UI design review board, landscape 1792x1200 or comparable high resolution, with THREE LARGE equally sized portrait phone screen mockups side by side. Title 'FunBox / 通用记分 V1', subtitle '02 实时记分 · 批量给分 · 结束结算'. Faithfully continue existing project's visual style: light gray blue #f5f7fa, white rounded cards, primary electric blue #2d5bff, navy #172139, muted #7b879c, coral #ff765e for negative values, green for positive values, pale blue input fills. Crisp PingFang Simplified Chinese. Soft shadows, airy usable mobile UI, restrained generic 3D score sheet and check illustrations. No physical devices. Include normal mini-program status and navigation bars. Absolutely NO Mahjong elements, compass seats, playing cards, dice, chips, poker, or felt tables. Use only people initials and generic score graphics.
SCREEN 1 navigation title '通用记分'. Compact white header '周末好友局', meta '房间 682915 · 6 人', green '实时同步', small '进行中'. Header action '成员'. White score card heading '积分榜' meta '实时比分'. Six compact ranked rows: 1 小林 我 +48, 2 阿杰 +24, 3 可可 +8, 4 阿安 −12, 5 小雨 −28, 6 阿北 −40. These scores sum exactly zero. Each has small neutral circular colored Chinese initial avatar; highlight own row pale blue, green positive / coral negative. Small primary blue button '给好友记分' beneath card. Separate white card '记分记录' '查看全部 ›', sample rows '小雨 → 小林   12 分', '阿北 → 阿杰   8 分', subdued time '刚刚' / '2 分钟前'. Bottom outline button '结束并结算'. No automatic rounds, no mahjong terminology. List works for more than 4 people.
SCREEN 2 same room screen darkened behind a tall white bottom sheet, handle and close X, title '给好友记分', subtitle '填写你要给出的分数，可一次给多人'. Blue tinted own account strip '小林（我） 当前 +48 分'. Five compact editable recipient rows, each with initial avatar, nickname, current score smaller, number input and suffix 分. 阿杰 current +24 input 8, 可可 current +8 input 0, 阿安 current −12 input 0, 小雨 current −28 input 4, 阿北 current −40 input 0. Text '填 0 或留空表示不给分'. Summary '本次给出 12 分' coral 12, smaller '你的积分：+48 → +36'. Blue fullwidth '确认给分'. This models exactly existing giver-to-recipients zero sum transfers; do not add arbitrary scoring modes, plus minus score editing or new workflows.
SCREEN 3 navigation title '结算结果'. Small 3D blue generic score sheet check illustration at top; title '本次记分已结束', subtitle '周末好友局 · 6 人'. White card '最终积分' six rows same scores +48 +24 +8 −12 −28 −40 as screen1, names 小林 阿杰 可可 阿安 小雨 阿北. Gray metadata '折算标准：1 分 = ¥1.00'. White card '转账建议' four compact rows: '阿北 → 小林 ¥40.00', '小雨 → 小林 ¥8.00', '小雨 → 阿杰 ¥20.00', '阿安 → 阿杰 ¥4.00', '阿安 → 可可 ¥8.00'. All transfers consistent with displayed score totals. Bottom '返回首页' blue button; secondary link '查看记分记录'. Use five transfer rows ensure fit. No payment action. Small footnote '结算时确认每分金额，结算后不可修改'.
Below each screen brief design annotations '6 人示例 · 更多成员纵向滚动' / '复用多人给分方式' / '积分与转账建议清楚可查'. Entire board initial proposal not implementation. Chinese legible, no gibberish, no excessive text.
